0x0083BF: An over-technology research institute in Colorado, North America, founded in New Era 171 by Bian Zoldark. Its famed alumni include robotics authorities Jonathan Kazahara and Erik Wan. Though most members left when the <EOTI Organization> was founded, it continues independent <EOT> research, <Tesla Drive> improvements, and Grungust-series development. Its name derives from inventor Nikola Tesla and scientist Wilhelm Reich. Jonathan Kazahara is its current director.
0x0086D2: A deep brainwave governing human thought, proposed by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi. Used to gauge Psychodriver aptitude.
0x0087BB: A squad formed to research and develop combat techniques and motion data for humanoid mobile weapons. The basic motion data in the <TC-OS> of current Personal Troopers came from their repeated trials. Its six elites were captain Kar-Wai Lau, Kai Kitamura, Tempest Hawker, Sanger Zonvolt, Elzam V. Branstein, and Gilliam Yeager. It disbanded after an incident in New Era 184, but its colorful members and achievements made it semi-legendary in and beyond the Federation Army. It was re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>, with Kai Kitamura as captain.
0x008BA4: Special humanoid mobile weapons, popularly called Super Robots: mainly units over 40 meters with special power sources or systems.
0x008C88: A substance discovered in Meteor 3. It does not occur naturally in the Solar System and was found sealed in clearly artificial containers. Each piece is a rice-grain-sized metal holding enormous energy. Six existed in Meteor 3 and were analyzed by the <EOTI Organization>; some were provided to the Federation Army through deals involving Major Ingram Prisken of the SRX Project. The Tronium Engine extracts this virtually inexhaustible energy as motive power; its energy conversion per unit time is immeasurable. As materials at Earth's technological level cannot withstand the high energy produced, limiters are installed. Raising output also accelerates energy generation, making output control extremely difficult.
0x00919B: A revolt in New Era 186 at the Earth Federation Army's Coatsland Base, Antarctica. The base was unveiling the Shirogane, first Space Noah-class multipurpose battle carrier, and the Granzon, a humanoid mobile weapon developed by the <EOTI Organization>. This was camouflage: in secret, peace talks were underway with extraterrestrials codenamed the 'Guests'. The terms, however, amounted to Earth's near-total capitulation, outraging many who knew the truth. During the talks Dr. Shu Shirakawa, a developer and test pilot of the Granzon, suddenly attacked the Guests' spacecraft, then turned on the Federation forces, leaving the base devastated. Negotiations collapsed, and the <DC> rose up soon after, triggering the wars that followed (the <DC War>, <L5 Campaign>, and <Inspector Incident>). As the Guests had arrived over the base in an <Aerogaters> ship, many at the time equated the two. Since the <Inspector Incident>, the prevailing view is that the ship was a decoy and the Guests are not Aerogaters but a force closely tied to the <Inspectors>.
0x0098EE: A military organization formed after the <L5 Campaign> by Van Vat Tran, uniting <DC> remnants and anti-Federationists with <Shadow Mirror> aid. It rose in arms in New Era 187 to unify the Earth Sphere by force, but its true enemies were invading aliens, and the Inspectors' arrival brought a truce with the Federation. During the North America recapture, Van died in a Shadow Mirror scheme and the group collapsed; remnants continue guerrilla resistance.
0x009C0D: A general term for humanoid mobile weapons developed to counter the 10-meter-plus articulated mobile weapons the Aerogaters were believed to possess. The first Personal Trooper, the <Mao Industries> PTX-001 Gespenst, rolled out in New Era 180. It features easy weapon swapping via manipulators and high mobility from bipedal walking and hovering. Under the <TC-OS> the pilot focuses on judgment: minimal input lets the machine automatically select motions to achieve the pilot's intent.
